_not_reachable: From the supplied list, these could NOT be reached by any adapter and are
not included. Most run on Workday or SAP SuccessFactors, which have no
public unauthenticated board API, or on fully custom career sites:
Workday:      Siemens, Siemens Healthineers, Infineon, adidas, PUMA,
SuccessFactors: DATEV, Audi, MAN, MTU, Rohde & Schwarz, Munich Re,
Custom:       BMW, Diehl, Fraunhofer IIS, Fraunhofer IKS, Stylight, Dalus
Not found on the guessed ATS: Agile Robots, NavVis and Kinexon (not on
SmartRecruiters), Flix, IDnow, Scalable Capital, Westwing,
Alasco, Fernride, ARX Robotics, Isar Aerospace, Marvel Fusion,
DeepDrive, Motius, Alexander Thamm, itestra, Consol, Zuehlke,
Most of these still surface through the Bundesagentur searches above, which
index employers regardless of which ATS they run.
Aggregators (startup.jobs, YC, Wellfound, BayStartUP, Munich Startup,
GermanTechJobs) have no public JSON API and would need the opt-in browser
adapter, which is disabled by default and has never been live-tested.
